mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair tamoxifen metabolism and increase cardiotoxicity risk; both agents have potential for QT prolongation and cardiac toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cardiac status closely; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use; consider lipid formulations of amphotericin B to reduce nephrotoxicity.
